sstc.title: Warranty operations
sstc.problem: A warranty process spanning customer intake, shipping, inspection and returns.
sstc.ownership: Backend Developer Intern; sole developer from requirements and data design to testing and handover.
sstc.delivered: A 29-state workflow and 57 schema migrations, with complete source handover.
sstc.decision: Backend-owned business rules; AI is limited to language extraction.

unihub.title: Workshop platform
unihub.problem: Registration, asynchronous payments and check-in with unreliable venue Wi-Fi.
unihub.ownership: Admin panel, offline QR check-in, Redis and database design in a team of two.
unihub.delivered: Workshop administration and an offline-capable check-in flow.
unihub.decision: Handle competing registrations explicitly; scan offline and sync on reconnect.

lunfa.title: AI writing tutor
lunfa.problem: Help Chinese learners correct their own sentences without giving away the answer.
lunfa.ownership: Freelance full-stack developer in a team of two, from requirements through deployment.
lunfa.delivered: A completed writing tutor delivered to a university research group.
lunfa.decision: Structured AI responses with layered malformed-output recovery and safe fallbacks.

coffee.title: Coffee-shop management
coffee.problem: Connect staff ordering, role-specific operations and management reporting.
coffee.ownership: POS/order module, system UI/UX and requirements analysis in a team of four.
coffee.delivered: A coffee-shop management product deployed for use at a GUTA shop.
coffee.decision: Model the POS and order journey around the staff workflow.

auction.title: Online marketplace
auction.problem: Keep concurrent bids, anti-sniping and post-auction handoff coherent.
auction.ownership: Bidder/seller flows, database, UI/UX, chat and order tracking in a team of two.
auction.delivered: A marketplace with 17 relational tables and 50+ documented endpoints.
auction.decision: Use PostgreSQL row-level locking around competing bid updates.

homestay.title: Rental registration
homestay.problem: Track residents from inquiry and viewing to deposit, contract and move-out.
homestay.ownership: Registration module, Prisma schema, UI/UX and requirements analysis in a team of four.
homestay.delivered: Bed-level availability and a registration, viewing and deposit workflow.
homestay.decision: Track allocation at bed level and make registration transitions explicit.

petcare.title: Veterinary clinic system
petcare.problem: Connect bookings, examinations, prescriptions and billing across staff roles.
petcare.ownership: Sole frontend/backend implementer in a team of four; teammates handled design.
petcare.delivered: A five-role clinic application with nine route groups.
petcare.decision: Use parameterized SQL and transactions for related data updates.

melodix.title: Android music app
melodix.problem: Support discovery, artist workflows and online/offline listening.
melodix.ownership: Artist, detail/search/share/profile flows, UI/UX and database co-design in a team of four.
melodix.delivered: Java Android flows using MVVM and a shared Supabase backend.
melodix.decision: Separate UI state, data access and playback responsibilities.
